title: fix: use no-store cache headers to prevent stale frontend chunks
key_points: Bug in ComfyUI causing stale frontend chunks due to incorrect cache headers
Problem is caused by Windows registry misconfiguration affecting Python mimetypes.guess_type()
Fix involves changing Cache-Control from no-cache to no-store for index.html, JS, CSS, and JSON entry points
limitations: Information may not be up-to-date due to the source being a pull request comment
Context is specific to ComfyUI software and might not apply universally
asserts: The main issue in this source is stale frontend chunks caused by incorrect cache headers, which can be fixed by changing Cache-Control from no-cache to no-store.
scope: This issue specifically applies to the ComfyUI software's frontend caching behavior.
